name: Jiuzhitang Co., Ltd.
summary: Jiuzhitang Co., Ltd. provides traditional Chinese, chemical, biological, and health medicine products in China. It offers Shuxuetong injections, Angong Niuhuang pills, Tianma Gouteng granules, Danxi granules, and Compound Lipid-Reducing tablets for cardiovascular and neurological treatment; Nude Flower Zizhu tablets, Xiaojin pills, Guizhi Fuling pills, Buxue Shengru granules, and Zhixue Zhentong capsules for gynecological treatment; Houyan pills for ear, nose, and throat (ENT) diseases; Jianwei Yuyang tablets for digestion; and prescription drug product systems, Jiaxi Ganxian granules, and Chidan Tuihuang granules for liver diseases.
